name: A valid approved controlled candidate publishes once with official evidence and history
description: Focused deterministic journey; explicit reusable Python assertions are stored alongside this authored plan. Isolated labelled fixtures only for source mutations.

planSteps.description: In this isolated preview sign in as VAR_{operator_email} with the configured secret VAR_{password}. Open /operator and expand Isolated source verification. Select Publication and replay.
Click Publish valid snapshot. Assert auto_publish (first time) or unchanged (replay), and capture accepted version. These labelled snapshots use the actual protected publication service.
Click Publish valid snapshot again; assert unchanged and the same accepted version.

Search catalogue for Controlled joint scholarship with all windows; assert exactly one [TEST ONLY] Controlled joint scholarship. Open it and inspect Evidence you can inspect and Change history containing publication-1.0.0. Assert durable publication event IDs are retained in operator decision provenance. Expand Recent automatic publications in Discovery & publication and inspect the entry named [TEST ONLY] Controlled joint scholarship. Verify its Durable publication event IDs section contains actual IDs.
